desc: Build + boot sweep: ./scripts/build.sh (log must contain 'zipping data/pak_1' — shader edits force the repack; if absent, force repack via RELEASE=1 BIN_DIR=$(pwd)/../build/c-game ../scripts/data.sh from c-game/ and same for c-engine, then rebuild). Then per mode N in 0,1 first (gate: mode 1 must show a dark shadow region under player in overlay, mode 0 must not — else stop, this is caster/cascade-pick/repack, reframe): TERM=xterm-256color ENGINE_AUTOTEST=enter ENGINE_HIDDEN_WINDOW=1 VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/radeon_icd.json ENGINE_SHADOW_MODE=N ENGINE_TELEPORT=180,640,180 ENGINE_SPLAT_SHADOW_DEBUG=2 ENGINE_SCREENSHOT=/tmp/shmN.jpg ./build/c-game/c-game; check 'shadow: mode N' log line ('shadow: disabled' for 0), zero VUIDs, shot contains streamed-in terrain (if empty ground, relaunch once). If gate passes, sweep N=2,3,4 the same way -> /tmp/shm2..4.jpg.

Mask-parity check: compare /tmp/shm2..4.jpg overlay screenshots against /tmp/shm1.jpg — each filterable mode (2=VSM, 3=EVSM2, 4=EVSM4) must show a dark terrain shadow region under the player of the same shape/extent as PCF's (softer allowed, no acne or light-bleeding artifacts in lit areas); /tmp/shm0.jpg shows no shadows; flag any failing/marginal mode

Dispatch only if task 2 flagged a mode: RenderDoc capture (ENGINE_RENDERDOC_CAPTURE=1 via ./scripts/run.sh renderdoc) + scripts/rdc.py dump of the 'shadow' and 'world' passes; verify atlas layout per mode (VSM/EVSM2 RG32, EVSM4 RGBA32, non-trivial moments) to split generator vs receiver; fix the splat PS branch or ShadowDiligent.cpp fVSMBias/fEVSM exponents (one coherent change), rebuild, re-run task 1 sweep for that mode only

Final pass: un-overlaid mode-1 screenshot (/tmp/shm_final.jpg, no ENGINE_SPLAT_SHADOW_DEBUG) confirming shipping look, settings.json shadowMode=1, DebugGui 0-4 toggle works, no VUIDs in any run; report per-mode verdict
